cases.explain: «Обед» is the subject of «был накрыт», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: приехал еще Тушкевич с поручением от ___ Бетси.
cases.translation: Tushkevich also arrived with an errand from Princess Betsy.
cases.explain: The preposition «от» governs the Genitive case: «от княгини».

cases.sentence: Анна весело рассказывала ___, что она купила нынче утром.
cases.translation: Anna cheerfully told Vronsky what she had bought that morning.
cases.explain: «Вронскому» is the indirect object of «рассказывала» ("to tell someone"), hence Dative.

cases.sentence: Я поехала бы, если бы можно было достать ___.
cases.translation: I would go, if it were possible to get a box.
cases.explain: «Ложу» is the direct object of the transitive verb «достать», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: просила Анну приехать к ней между половиной седьмого и девятью ___.
cases.translation: she asked Anna to come to her between half past six and nine o'clock.
cases.explain: The preposition «между» governs the Instrumental case: «между ... девятью часами».

cases.sentence: Анна уже была одета в платье, которое она сшила в ___.
cases.translation: Anna was already dressed in the gown she had made in Paris.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (location) governs the Prepositional case: «в Париже».

reading.ru: Когда Вронский вернулся домой, Анны не было еще дома.
reading.question: What did Vronsky find when he returned home?
options: Anna was waiting anxiously for him
Anna had already gone to bed
reading.explain: The chapter opens by stating that when Vronsky returned home, Anna was not yet there.

reading.ru: Вскоре после него, как ему сказали, к ней приехала какая-то дама, и она с нею вместе уехала.
reading.question: What had Anna done shortly before Vronsky's return, according to what he was told?
options: Some lady had come to see her and they had driven off together
She had gone to visit Seryozha again
She had left a note and gone to the theatre alone
She had gone shopping with Vronsky's mother
reading.correct: Some lady had come to see her and they had driven off together
reading.explain: He was told that soon after he left, some lady had come to Anna and the two had driven off together.

reading.ru: Он решил, что необходимо объясниться с ней, и он ждал ее в ее гостиной.
reading.question: What did Vronsky decide to do after growing suspicious of Anna's behavior?
options: He decided it was necessary to have things out with her and waited in her drawing room
He decided to leave for the theater without her
He decided to write her a letter
He decided to ask Yashvin to talk to her
reading.correct: He decided it was necessary to have things out with her and waited in her drawing room
reading.explain: He decided that he must have an explanation with her, and waited for her in her drawing room.

reading.ru: Но Анна вернулась не одна, а привезла с собой свою тетку, старую деву, княжну Облонскую.
reading.question: Who did Anna bring back with her?
options: Her aunt, the old maid Princess Oblonskaya
reading.correct: Her aunt, the old maid Princess Oblonskaya
reading.explain: Anna returned not alone, but brought with her her aunt, the old maid, Princess Oblonskaya.

reading.question: How many places was dinner set for?
reading.explain: The text states dinner was laid for four.

reading.ru: Княгиня Бетси просила извинить, что она не приехала проститься.
reading.question: What message did Tushkevich bring from Princess Betsy?
options: An apology for not coming to say goodbye, since she was unwell, and an invitation for Anna to visit her
An invitation to a ball that evening
A request that Anna come to Petersburg permanently
News that Betsy had left for abroad
reading.correct: An apology for not coming to say goodbye, since she was unwell, and an invitation for Anna to visit her
reading.explain: Princess Betsy asked to be excused for not coming to say goodbye because she was unwell, but asked Anna to visit her.

reading.ru: Он решительно не понимал, что делала Анна.
reading.question: What was Vronsky's reaction to Anna's behavior with the old princess and Tushkevich?
options: He was utterly unable to understand what she was doing
He was delighted by her hospitality
He approved of her plan to go to the theater
reading.correct: He was utterly unable to understand what she was doing
reading.explain: The text says he decidedly could not understand what Anna was doing, wondering why she brought the old princess and kept Tushkevich for dinner.

reading.ru: За обедом Анна была наступательно весела, она как будто кокетничала и с Тушкевичем, и с Яшвином.
reading.question: How did Anna behave at dinner?
options: She was aggressively cheerful and seemed to flirt with both Tushkevich and Yashvin
reading.correct: She was aggressively cheerful and seemed to flirt with both Tushkevich and Yashvin
reading.explain: At dinner Anna was defiantly gay, seeming to flirt with both Tushkevich and Yashvin.

reading.ru: Анна уже была одета в светлое шелковое с бархатом платье, которое она сшила в Париже, с открытой грудью и с белым дорогим кружевом на голове, обрамлявшим ее лицо и особенно выгодно выставлявшим ее яркую красоту.
reading.question: What was Anna wearing when Vronsky came upstairs?
options: A light silk-and-velvet gown made in Paris, with an open bodice and lace on her head
A borrowed dress from her aunt
reading.correct: A light silk-and-velvet gown made in Paris, with an open bodice and lace on her head
reading.explain: Anna was already dressed in a light silk gown trimmed with velvet, made in Paris, with an open bosom and costly white lace on her head.

reading.ru: Но теперь именно красота и элегантность ее были то самое, что раздражало его.
reading.question: How did Vronsky's feelings about Anna's beauty change in this scene?
options: Her beauty and elegance now irritated him rather than pleasing him
He found her more beautiful than ever and was reassured
He no longer noticed her appearance at all
reading.correct: Her beauty and elegance now irritated him rather than pleasing him
reading.explain: The text says it was precisely her beauty and elegance that now irritated him.

reading.ru: Она не слышала слов, но видела холодность взгляда и с раздражением отвечала.
reading.question: How did Anna respond to Vronsky's cold look as he pleaded with her not to go?
options: She did not hear his words but saw the coldness in his look and answered with irritation
She burst into tears and agreed to stay
She left the room without a word
reading.correct: She did not hear his words but saw the coldness in his look and answered with irritation
reading.explain: The text says she did not hear his words but saw the coldness of his glance and answered with irritation.
